thread:
owen (acct exec): Hey team, Orion Health wants to kick off a 2-week Dedicated POC. They asked for a SOC 2 excerpt, a short bridge/ack letter, and a mutual NDA before we share anything. They also want a scoped temporary API key + read-only console during the trial. Can legal + security confirm what we can provide and the fastest path? cc @sarah (legal) @nidhi (security)

 sarah (legal): We can send a heavily redacted SOC 2 excerpt (opinion, scope, control families). We cannot share auditor workpapers, internal control identifiers, or network diagrams. For the bridge letter: we have a one-page template that confirms SOC 2 coverage and the anticipated date of the next full report; it must be narrow in scope (only inference hosting). Need to confirm whether they insist on mutual NDA or will accept a one-way.

 owen (acct exec): They sent a signed request that says "mutual NDA preferred". They want to sign quickly so they can provision engineers. Any chance we can bundle NDA + SOC 2 excerpt + bridge letter in one packet and e-sign?

 nidhi (security): Bundling is fine once legal approves. For the temporary API key: we can issue a short-lived key (72 hours) scoped to the customer's project and rate-limited. For console access: we can create time-bound read-only sessions via an IAM role with ConsoleReadOnly and CloudWatchLogsRead permissions. If they request raw request/response logs, we need to sanitize PII. Also: no hostnames or internal host IDs in shared telemetry.

 devon (eng): On the Dedicated side we'll need a ticket to reserve a small GPU pool and pin model v2.0.0-optimized. We'll disable autoscaling beyond reserved capacity for the POC window. Also need a billing contact or PO for trial credits. Who owns the pricing and PO follow-up?

 owen (acct exec): I'll handle pricing and PO. Legal: can you prepare the mutual NDA for DocuSign and include the bridge-letter draft? Security: what inputs do you need from the customer to scope the access?

 sarah (legal): I'll prepare a DocuSign mutual NDA and attach: 1) redacted SOC 2 excerpt (PDF, watermark: "REDACTED"), 2) draft bridge letter addressed to Orion Health, and 3) a short cover note explaining limits of disclosures. I can have the package ready by EOD tomorrow if they sign ASAP.

 nidhi (security): I'll need: customer domain, list of authorized emails, desired resource types (console read-only, API key, log exports), and whether test data contains real PII. For API keys we'll scope by project name (e.g., orion-poc) and set a hard token expiry. For log exports we'll provide presigned S3 links with 7-day expiry and sanitized payloads. Provision ETA: ~24 hours after NDA & disclosure record.

 disclosure-bot: POLICY: Per SH-3, SOC 2 excerpts externally shared must omit auditor workpapers and control identifiers. All external disclosures require a recorded recipient list and a disclosure ticket.

 owen (acct exec): Customer details: org domain orionhealth.com. Authorized users: emma@orionhealth.com, raj@orionhealth.com. They want: 1) read-only console for 48 hours, 2) scoped API key for the POC (72h), 3) request/response logs for the POC window. I'll ask them about PII in test data.

 sarah (legal): Great. I'll draft mutual NDA in DocuSign, include the SOC 2 excerpt and bridge-letter draft, and add a one-paragraph note about log redaction requirements. Will tag nidhi when ready.

 devon (eng): Once the NDA is signed, open a JIRA ticket to eng-ops with: authorized emails, preferred POC window, and exact resource list. We'll prepare the dedicated pool and create the API key. Also need the billing contact for trial credits.

 owen (acct exec): I'll open the JIRA and attach the DocuSign envelope link. Plan: NDA -> sign (aim 48h) -> legal uploads redacted SOC2 + bridge -> security creates disclosure record + provisions -> eng provisions Dedicated + API key.

 nidhi (security): Note: if logs include request payloads we require explicit product-risk signoff to redact PII fields. Also we'll watermark any shared logs and include a short redaction report.

 owen (acct exec): Noted. I'll ask them to confirm whether they will use synthetic test data.

 sarah (legal): NDA envelope created: https://docusign.example/xyz789. I'll set signing order and request mutual signatures. Once signed I'll upload the redacted SOC 2 excerpt and bridge letter into the disclosure ticket.

 disclosure-bot: ACTION: create disclosure record #D-2026-210 when SOC2 excerpt is uploaded. Ensure recipient list matches signed NDA.

 owen (acct exec): DocuSign delivered to customer. I'll update when signed. Thanks all. :pray:
